source: Kandal Provincial Department of Agriculture (មន្ទីរកសិកម្មខេត្តកណ្តាល), "ដំណំពោត" (Corn Crop / Zea mays production manual), 2015
text: Stem blotch disease (ជម្ងឺអុចឆ្នោត): this is a fungal disease with symptoms including brown, blister-like lesions on the leaf sheath. It commonly occurs in humid conditions, particularly affecting waxy/sticky corn varieties (ពោតខ្វើយ). It shows similar spotting symptoms on the leaf, stem, and seed. This disease does not directly damage the corn kernels themselves. In Cambodia this disease is commonly reported occurring on wet soil, and where excess nitrogen fertilizer has been applied.
